d2Membership.commitments.books: We publish the books every month.
d2Membership.commitments.trackers: No ads sold on your data. No third-party trackers.
d2Membership.decisions.title: Recent decisions
d2Membership.faq.title: Questions
d2Membership.faq.refund.a: Yes. Leave the co-op and the share is refunded in full. It isn't an investment and it doesn't grow.
d2Membership.faq.refund.aKept: Not on this co-op: members voted to keep the share when someone leaves. It isn't an investment and it doesn't grow.
d2Membership.faq.sub.a: Yes. While you pay for a sub of {minSub} or more a month to someone else's channel, you're a viewer member. Gifted subs don't count. If the sub ends, so does that membership, unless you also hold a share.
d2Membership.faq.vote.ordinary: Ordinary votes need at least {quorum} of members to take part, and at least {threshold} of the yes and no votes to be yes.
d2Membership.faq.vote.protected: Protected decisions, like the creator share, need at least {quorum} of members to take part and {threshold} yes across all members, plus at least {streamerQuorum} of streamer members taking part and {streamerThreshold} of them voting yes. The creator council reviews them first.
d2Membership.faq.first.a: On the next vote that opens, yes. Who can vote is fixed when voting opens, so a vote already under way stays with the members it opened with. You can comment on proposals still in discussion.
d2Membership.faq.streamer.q: I stream. Do I need to do anything?
d2Membership.faq.streamer.a: No. Once you've streamed on {site} for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} to {viewers, plural, one {# or more verified viewers} other {# or more verified viewers}} over the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, you become a streamer member on your own. We check every hour.
d2Membership.end.body: {shareAmount}, refunded if you leave. Or subscribe to someone else's channel at {minSub} or more a month.
d2Membership.end.bodyKept: A {shareAmount} share, one time. Or subscribe to someone else's channel at {minSub} or more a month.
d2Membership.end.shareOnly: {shareAmount}, refunded if you leave. One member, one vote.
d2Membership.end.shareOnlyKept: A {shareAmount} share, one time. One member, one vote.

d2Membership.firstVote.nothingOpen: Nothing is up for a vote right now. We'll tell you when the next proposal opens.
d2Membership.firstVote.votedAll: You've voted on everything open to you.
d2Membership.vote.joinedAfter: You joined after this vote opened, so it stays with the members it opened with. You'll vote on proposals that open from now on.
d2Membership.vote.notMember: Only co-op members vote. Join, and you'll vote on proposals that open after you do.
d2Membership.welcome.title: Welcome to the co-op
d2Membership.welcome.body: You're a co-op member now. Your sub makes you a viewer member while it lasts.
d2Membership.support.memberNotice: A {minSub}+ monthly sub also makes you a co-op member: one vote, and a say in how the co-op is run.
d2Membership.support.memberOnConfirm: Once the co-op confirms your payment, your sub makes you a co-op member. We'll tell you in your inbox.
